meeting.title: Discovery call — Inventory & Purchasing Platform for Norte Distribuciones

meeting_summary.context_and_problem: Norte Distribuciones is a mid-size distributor of industrial spare parts (about 12,000 active SKUs, 3 warehouses in two cities, 45 employees, about 600 orders/day). Inventory is tracked today in shared Excel files plus a 12-year-old desktop ERP (SAP Business One 9.3, on-premise) that is only used for invoicing. Consequences reported by the client: frequent stock-outs of fast-moving parts, about 4% mismatch between physical and recorded stock, purchase orders created by email, and no visibility of stock across warehouses. Stock counts take 2 full days per quarter.
meeting_summary.goal: Replace the spreadsheets with a web-based inventory and purchasing platform that gives real-time stock per warehouse, tracks every stock movement, automates reorder suggestions, and manages purchase orders end to end. Success criteria stated by the client: stock accuracy above 98%, stock-outs of top-200 SKUs reduced by 50% within 6 months, quarterly count reduced to 1 day.
in_scope: Product catalog: SKUs with variants, categories, units of measure, supplier(s), min/max stock levels. Bulk CSV import/export.
Multi-warehouse and bin-location management (3 warehouses, about 40 locations each).
Stock movements ledger: goods receipt, issue, transfer between warehouses, manual adjustment with reason. Every movement is immutable and audited.
Purchase orders: supplier management, PO creation, approval flow (2 levels above a configurable amount), partial receipts, PDF/email to supplier.
Low-stock alerts and reorder suggestions based on min levels and last-90-day consumption.
Barcode support: generate labels (Code128) and scan with the phone camera from the browser (no native app).
Dashboard: stock value, stock-outs, slow movers, open POs, movements per day. Reports exportable to CSV/XLSX.
Roles: Admin, Warehouse Operator, Purchasing, Read-only (manager). Login with the client's Microsoft Entra ID (OIDC SSO).
One-way sync of products and stock levels to the existing SAP B1, running hourly (confirmed in the call).
One-time migration of current Excel data.
out_of_scope: Hardware procurement: scanners and label printers (the client buys them)
constraints: Budget ceiling communicated informally: about USD 55k.
Hard deadline: go-live before the high season starting 2026-09-01, so development must finish by mid-July at the latest. Kickoff is planned for 2026-04-06.
Data residency: data must stay in the AWS sa-east-1 (Sao Paulo) region.
The IT Coordinator is only available about 4 h/week; business stakeholders can attend one weekly 1-hour demo/feedback session.
Warehouse Wi-Fi is unreliable in one location; the UI must tolerate slow connections (no offline mode, but retries and clear error states).
Users are not technical: the main flows (receive, issue, transfer) must take at most 3 taps/clicks from the home screen on a phone.
Target scale: up to 15 concurrent users, 12k SKUs, about 2,000 movements/day, 5 years of history.

proposed_stack.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Tailwind + component library, PWA for camera scanning (ZXing).
proposed_stack.backend: Node.js 20 + NestJS (REST, OpenAPI), PostgreSQL 15 (RDS), Prisma ORM, BullMQ + Redis for background jobs (imports, alerts, ERP sync).
proposed_stack.auth: Microsoft Entra ID via OIDC, roles mapped from groups.
proposed_stack.infra: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, SES, CloudWatch), Terraform, GitHub Actions CI/CD, 3 environments (dev, staging, prod).
proposed_stack.quality: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Sentry.

integrations: Microsoft Entra ID (SSO): client IT already has a tenant and will create the app registration.

SAP Business One 9.3 on-premise: the Service Layer is enabled (confirmed by client IT during the call). Access from AWS goes through a site-to-site VPN that client IT will provide; sync is one-way (platform to SAP) and hourly.
Amazon SES for email; supplier email templates provided by the client.
assumptions: Client provides Excel data within 2 weeks of kickoff; data cleaning of up to 12k rows is done by the client, we only validate and load it.
A single approval workflow (configurable threshold), not a generic workflow engine.
Up to 18 distinct screens in the high-fidelity design; the client has no brand guide beyond a logo.
Client feedback within 2 business days; one consolidated round of changes per demo.
2 UAT cycles of 1 week each, executed by the client.
Purchase order approval: orders up to USD 2,000 are approved by the Purchasing Manager; above that, the COO also approves. The threshold is configurable by an Admin.
Reports beyond the dashboard: 5 reports (stock by warehouse, movements by period, slow movers, supplier performance, open POs).
The client provides the label printer (Zebra, 100x50 mm labels) and the scanners; Bluetooth/USB HID scanners work as keyboard input with no extra development.
Spanish/English scope includes the UI, emails and PDFs.
Support after hypercare is out of this estimate and handled under a separate agreement.

risks.description: SAP B1 9.3 is an old version; the Service Layer is enabled but the integration depends on the client's VPN and on SAP-side permissions being granted on time.
Data quality of the Excel files (duplicate SKUs, inconsistent units) may delay migration and the stock accuracy goal.
Limited client availability (IT 4 h/week) can block SSO setup, VPN and UAT.
Budget (about 55k) is tight relative to scope; scope creep around reports and approval rules is likely.
Browser camera barcode scanning is less reliable on low-end Android devices and in low light; the fallback is a USB/Bluetooth HID scanner.
Fixed go-live date before high season leaves little slack; any delay in kickoff impacts directly.

SAP Business One one-way sync (Service Layer client over VPN, hourly job, mapping, retries, reconciliation)

App shell, routing, API client generation from OpenAPI, state/query setup
Login flow, role-based route guards and session expiry handling
Catalog screens: list with filters/search, detail, create/edit, variants
Warehouses and locations screens
